name: services.openssh.enable
description: Whether to enable the OpenSSH secure shell daemon, which allows secure remote logins.

name: services.openssh.ports
type: list of 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive)
description: Specifies on which ports the SSH daemon listens.

name: services.openssh.settings.PermitRootLogin
description: Whether the root user can login using ssh.

name: services.openssh.settings.PasswordAuthentication
description: Specifies whether password authentication is allowed.

name: services.jellyfin.enable
description: Whether to enable Jellyfin Media Server.

name: services.jellyfin.openFirewall
description: Open the default ports in the firewall for the media server.

name: services.tailscale.enable
description: Whether to enable Tailscale client daemon.

name: services.tailscale.useRoutingFeatures
description: Enables settings required for Tailscale's routing features like subnet routers and exit nodes.

name: services.nginx.virtualHosts.<name>.root
description: The path of the web root directory.

name: networking.firewall.allowedTCPPorts
type: list of 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive)
description: List of TCP ports on which incoming connections are accepted.

name: time.timeZone
description: The time zone used when displaying times and dates.

name: programs.steam.enable
description: Whether to enable steam.

name: virtualisation.docker.enable
description: This option enables docker, a daemon that manages linux containers.

name: system.stateVersion
description: This option defines the first version of NixOS you have installed on this particular machine.

name: system.nixos.release
description: The NixOS release (e.g. 16.03).

name: home-manager.users.<name>.programs.git.enable
description: Whether to enable Git.

name: home-manager.users.<name>.programs.git.settings
description: Configuration written to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/config.

name: home-manager.users.<name>.programs.starship.enable
description: Whether to enable starship.

name: home-manager.users.<name>.home.sessionVariables
type: lazy attribute set of (string or path or signed integer or floating point number)
description: Environment variables to always set at login.

name: home-manager.users.<name>.home.stateVersion
description: The home-manager release whose defaults this configuration keeps.
